description: As a remote sensing scientist preparing a comprehensive land surface characterization report for an agricultural ministry, analyze the Landsat multispectral imagery at /home/ga/snap_data/landsat_multispectral.tif in SNAP Desktop. The file contains four spectral bands (band_1=SWIR1, band_2=NIR, band_3=Red, band_4=Green). Derive a comprehensive suite of at least four spectral indices that characterize different surface properties — vegetation vigor, water presence, soil exposure, and soil-adjusted vegetation. Additionally, create a classified land cover map that categorizes each pixel into at least three thematic classes based on the spectral index values. Save the complete analysis product in BEAM-DIMAP format and export as GeoTIFF to /home/ga/snap_exports/.
